title: Shared information.
description: See what you've shared and manage future access.
emptyDescription: Every share starts with your choice and confirmation.
sessionNotice: These are sharing simulations from this session. No information was sent. Records clear when the app reloads or you confirm a session reset or leave the demo.
revokeDescription: This asks the simulated sharing service to end access to the selected demo share. It is removed from this list only after the service confirms. No real access is changed. Source wellness data and saved information stay unchanged.
copiesNotice: Revoking stops future access only. Information a recipient already downloaded, copied or forwarded cannot be recalled.
revokePending: Waiting for the simulated sharing service to confirm revocation. Access is unchanged until it confirms.
revokePendingLabel: Revocation pending · access unchanged until confirmed
revokeFailed: The simulated sharing service could not revoke this share. Access is unchanged. Try again.
revokeUnknown: No response from the simulated sharing service. Access may be unchanged. Trying again is safe and will not create a second request.
revokedNotice: Demo access revoked. The selected share has been removed.
previewNotice: This confirms a simulated share only. Nothing is sent and no recipient receives anything. A confirmed recipient share appears in Shared Information for this session. Export previews are not recorded there.
